s1.p1a: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of

s1.p2: Access to the game and its features is free. No payment is currently required to use the service.

s2.title: 2. User account
s2.p1: Some Scoundrel's Quest features require a user account.
s2.p2: The account may be created through Scoundrel's Quest's own registration system or through the third-party authentication services available at any given time, currently Google and X.
s2.p3: The user must provide accurate information and keep the information necessary for the operation of their account up to date.
s2.p4: The user is responsible for keeping their credentials confidential and for any activity carried out through their account.
s2.p5: Passwords for accounts created through the site's own system are stored using hashing mechanisms and not in plain text.

s3.title: 3. Communications related to the account
s3.p1: The email address associated with an account may be used to send the communications necessary for the management and operation of the service.
s3.p2: These communications include the automatic welcome email sent when an account is created, as well as communications related to support requests and error reports.
s3.p3: These communications are functional in nature and do not constitute advertising or subscriptions to commercial communications.

s4.title: 4. Permitted use
s4.p1: The user undertakes to use Scoundrel's Quest in a lawful and responsible manner and in accordance with these terms.
s4.p2: The service may not be used to carry out activities that could damage, overload, interfere with or compromise the normal operation of the game, its servers, databases or related systems.
s4.p3: Nor is it permitted to attempt to obtain unauthorised access to accounts, servers, databases, APIs, authentication systems or any other infrastructure related to Scoundrel's Quest.
s4.p4: The user may not attempt to deliberately alter, manipulate or exploit errors in the game with the aim of gaining unfair advantages or harming other users.

s5.title: 5. User-generated content
s5.p1: Scoundrel's Quest allows users to customise certain elements of their profile with content they provide, including avatars and banners.
s5.p2: The user is responsible for the content they upload to the service and declares that they hold the rights, permissions or authorisations necessary to use that content.
s5.p3: It is not permitted to upload images, GIFs or other content that infringes copyright, trademarks, image rights, intellectual or industrial property rights, privacy rights or other third-party rights.
s5.p4: Nor is it permitted to upload content that is illegal, threatening, abusive, discriminatory, sexually explicit or that could harm other users or the operation of the service.
s5.p5: Scoundrel's Quest does not necessarily review all content provided by users in advance. Nevertheless, it may remove content or prevent access to it when it becomes aware that such content may be unlawful, infringe third-party rights or breach these terms.

s6.title: 6. Error reports and support
s6.p1: Scoundrel's Quest allows users to submit error reports and support requests.
s6.p2: The user must ensure that the information provided in these reports is relevant and sufficient to describe the problem.
s6.p3: Reports must not include passwords, authentication tokens, bank details or any other personal information that is not necessary to explain the problem.
s6.p4: Reports may be stored so that they can be managed, investigated and resolved.

s7.title: 7. Games and progress
s7.p1: Scoundrel's Quest may store information related to games, progress, achievements and other actions necessary to provide the features of the game.
s7.p2: This information is linked to the corresponding account where necessary in order to preserve the user's progress.
s7.p3: Although every effort is made to keep the information intact, permanent retention of games is not guaranteed in the event of technical failures, errors, maintenance, changes to the project or other circumstances.

s8.p1: Original elements created specifically for Scoundrel's Quest, including code, illustrations, characters, designs, texts and other content of the project, belong to their respective authors or are used with the corresponding authorisation.
s8.p2: Access to the game does not transfer any ownership rights over those elements to the user.
s8.p3: Unless expressly permitted by applicable law, the original content of Scoundrel's Quest may not be reproduced, distributed, modified, published or commercially exploited without the corresponding authorisation.

s9.p2: Scoundrel's Quest is an independent project and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, authorised or endorsed by Zach Gage or Kurt Bieg.
s9.p3: The characters, illustrations, designs and other artistic elements of Scoundrel's Quest have been developed specifically for this project.

s10.title: 10. Donations
s10.p1: Scoundrel's Quest is free and requires no payment to access the game.
s10.p2: The project may offer a voluntary link to Ko-fi for those who wish to make a donation and support its development.

s11.p3: The use of third-party services may be subject to the conditions established by their respective providers.

s12.title: 12. Service availability
s12.p1: Given that it is a personal and free project, there is no guarantee that Scoundrel's Quest will be available on a permanent or uninterrupted basis.
s12.p2: The service may experience interruptions, errors, maintenance, changes or technical limitations.
s12.p3: The project may be modified, suspended or discontinued at any time.

s13.title: 13. Changes to the game
s13.p1: Scoundrel's Quest's features, content, rules, systems and characteristics may change over time.
s13.p2: These changes may be made to fix errors, improve the game, introduce new features or maintain the project.

s14.title: 14. Breach of these terms
s14.p1: In the case of abusive, fraudulent, unlawful or harmful use of the service, access to the corresponding account may be restricted, suspended or cancelled where necessary to protect the game, other users or the infrastructure.

s1.p2: Scoundrel's Quest is a personal and independent project offered free of charge and without advertising.

s2.title: 2. What personal data do we process?
s2.intro: Depending on the features you use, Scoundrel's Quest may process the following categories of data:

li1.label: Account data:
li1.text: email address, username (nick) and data necessary to manage the account.

li2.label: Authentication data:
li2.text: information necessary to verify access to the account and tokens used to keep the session signed in.

li3.label: Third-party authentication data:
li3.text: when you use Google or X to sign in, we may receive from the provider the data it supplies in accordance with the integration's configuration, such as identifiers, email address, username or profile picture.

li4.label: Game data:
li4.text: information related to games, progress, achievements and other activities carried out within the service.

li5.label: Profile content:
li5.text: images, GIFs, avatar, banner or other content you choose to upload to your profile.

li6.label: Comments and submitted content:
li6.text: information you voluntarily enter in comments or other features of the service.

li7.label: Support and report data:
li7.text: title, description, type, severity, status and any other information you provide when reporting an error or incident.

li8.label: Technical report data:
li8.text: technical information associated with the submission of a report, such as the browser type and the type of device used.

li9.label: Technical data necessary for the service:
li9.text: information that may be necessary to ensure the security, operation and compatibility of the service.

s3.title: 3. Passwords
s3.p1: Passwords used for accounts created directly on Scoundrel's Quest are not stored in plain text. They are stored using hashing mechanisms designed to prevent their direct recovery.
s3.p2: Scoundrel's Quest does not request or store the password you use to access your Google or X accounts.

s4.title: 4. Purposes of processing
s4.intro: Personal data is processed primarily for the following purposes:
s4.li2: Allow users to sign in and sign out.
s4.li3: Manage authentication through Google and X.
s4.li4: Maintain the session and provide the features of the service.
s4.li5: Save and provide your progress, games and achievements.
s4.li6: Display and manage the customisation elements of your profile.
s4.li7: Manage comments and other interactions within the game.
s4.li8: Receive, analyse and resolve errors or incidents.
s4.li9: Improve the stability, compatibility and performance of the service.
s4.li10: Maintain the security of the service and prevent improper use.
s4.li11: Send the necessary communications relating to the account or to support requests.

s5.title: 5. Email communications
s5.p1: The email address associated with your account may be used for communications related to the operation of the service.
s5.p2: These communications may currently include, among others:
s5.li1: The welcome email after registering a new account.
s5.li2: Confirmations related to the error reports submitted.
s5.li3: Communications necessary to manage support requests.
s5.p3: These communications are functional in nature and do not constitute advertising or marketing communications.

s6.title: 6. Legal basis
s6.p1: The applicable legal basis will depend on the specific purpose of the processing.
s6.p2: In particular, certain processing activities are necessary to provide the features you request when using Scoundrel's Quest, such as creating an account, authentication, session maintenance or game management.
s6.p3: Other processing activities may be based on compliance with legal obligations, on the legitimate interest of the controller where applicable, or on the user's consent where this is required.

s7.title: 7. Signing in with Google
s7.p1: Scoundrel's Quest allows you to sign in using a Google account through the corresponding integration.
s7.p2: When you use this option, Google may provide Scoundrel's Quest with certain data associated with your account, in accordance with the permissions granted and the information available through the integration, such as your email address, identifier, username or profile picture.
s7.p3: Scoundrel's Quest neither receives nor stores the password you use to access Google.

s8.title: 8. Signing in with X
s8.p1: Scoundrel's Quest also allows you to sign in using an X account through the corresponding integration.
s8.p2: Depending on the information provided by X and on the permissions available, data such as a user identifier, username, email address or profile picture may be received.
s8.p3: Scoundrel's Quest neither receives nor stores the password you use to access X.
s8.p4: If the provider does not supply an email address, the account may be managed using other identifiers available to the integration.

s9.title: 9. Game data and progress
s9.p1: In order to provide the features of Scoundrel's Quest, we may store information related to games and to the activity carried out within the game.
s9.p2: This may include progress, games, results, achievements, comments and any other information necessary to provide the corresponding features.

s10.title: 10. Avatars, banners and user-uploaded content
s10.p1: Scoundrel's Quest allows users to customise certain elements of their profile, including avatars and banners.
s10.p2: The images, GIFs and any other content you upload may be stored and displayed as part of your profile.
s10.p3: The user is responsible for the content they upload and must hold the rights, permissions or authorisations necessary to use it.
s10.p4: Content that infringes copyright, trademarks, image rights, intellectual or industrial property rights, privacy rights or other third-party rights must not be uploaded.
s10.p5: If we receive a communication about content that is allegedly unlawful or that infringes third-party rights, we may review it and, where appropriate, remove it or prevent access to it.

s11.title: 11. Comments and user-submitted content
s11.p1: When you take part in features that allow you to post comments or other content, the information you enter may be stored and linked to your account.
s11.p2: You must not enter other people's personal data in these features when it is not necessary or when you are not authorised to do so.

s12.title: 12. Error reports and incidents
s12.p1: Scoundrel's Quest has a system for reporting errors, technical problems and incidents.
s12.intro: When you submit a report we may store information such as:
s12.li6: The date and time of creation.
s12.li7: The user associated with the report, where applicable.
s12.li8: Technical information associated with the submission, such as the browser and device type used.
s12.outro: This information is used to investigate problems, diagnose errors, resolve incidents and improve the operation and compatibility of Scoundrel's Quest.

s13.title: 13. Discord integration
s13.p1: To facilitate the internal management of error reports, Scoundrel's Quest uses an automated integration with Discord.
s13.p2: When a report is generated, certain information may be sent via a webhook to a private channel used to manage incidents.
s13.intro: The information sent to Discord may include:
s13.li6: The date and time of creation.
s13.li7: An internal link to the report within Scoundrel's Quest.
s13.p3: The technical information on the browser and device recorded by Scoundrel's Quest is not specifically sent to Discord through this integration.
s13.p4: Nevertheless, if the user themselves voluntarily includes personal data or technical information in the title or description of the report, such information could form part of the content sent to Discord.
s13.p5: The processing carried out by Discord is subject to its own terms and privacy policy.

s14.title: 14. Infrastructure and hosting
s14.p1: Account data and other information necessary to provide the service are stored in a MySQL database hosted on a private server (VPS) contracted with IONOS.
s14.p2: IONOS provides the infrastructure used to host the service. Where applicable, the corresponding contractual measures for the processing of personal data by the provider will be adopted.

s15.title: 15. Email service
s15.p1: Scoundrel's Quest uses an IONOS SMTP service to send certain functional emails, including welcome messages, report confirmations and communications related to support.
s15.p2: Sending these messages requires processing the recipient's email address and the information necessary to generate the corresponding message.

s16.title: 16. Cloudflare
s16.p1: Scoundrel's Quest's domain uses Cloudflare services mainly for DNS management and as a proxy service between users and the project's infrastructure.
s16.p2: Depending on the configuration and the security mechanisms used, Cloudflare may process certain technical data necessary to provide these services and to protect the infrastructure against abuse or malicious traffic.
s16.p3: Scoundrel's Quest does not use Google Analytics or any other advertising analytics systems to track users.

s17.title: 17. Google Search Console
s17.p1: Scoundrel's Quest uses Google Search Console to monitor matters related to the indexing and presence of the site in Google search.
s17.p2: The use of Search Console does not in itself imply the installation of Google Analytics or of analytics cookies on visitors' devices.

s18.title: 18. Google Analytics and advertising
s18.p1: Scoundrel's Quest does not currently use Google Analytics.
s18.p2: The project also does not use targeted advertising, advertising networks or systems intended to build advertising profiles of users.

s19.title: 19. Cookies and similar technologies
s19.p1: Scoundrel's Quest uses only the cookies and similar technologies necessary to provide certain features of the service, such as maintaining the session, managing authentication or remembering certain preferences.
s19.p2: These technologies are not currently used to serve targeted advertising or to build commercial profiles of users.
s19.p3a: For more detailed information about cookies, you can consult our

s20.title: 20. Data retention
s20.p1: Personal data will be retained for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected and for as long as a relationship with the service exists, unless a legal obligation requires further retention.
s20.p2: Certain technical data or logs may be retained for a reasonable period where necessary to ensure the security of the service, to investigate incidents or to resolve technical problems.
s20.p3: Error reports may be retained for as long as they are needed to manage and maintain a history of the project's technical incidents.

s21.title: 21. Security
s21.p1: Scoundrel's Quest applies reasonable technical and organisational measures intended to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration or improper disclosure.
s21.p2: These measures include, among others, the use of hashed passwords and token-based authentication mechanisms for sessions.
s21.p3: Nevertheless, no system connected to the internet can guarantee absolute security.

s22.title: 22. Recipients of the data
s22.p1: Personal data may be processed by the providers necessary for the operation of Scoundrel's Quest, within the purposes described in this policy.

li1.label: IONOS
li1.text: , for server infrastructure and email services.

li2.label: Cloudflare
li2.text: , for DNS and proxy services and for functions associated with protecting the infrastructure.

li3.label: Discord
li3.text: , for the internal management of error reports through the automated integration described above.

li4.label: Google and X
li4.text: , when the user chooses to use their respective sign-in systems.

s22.outro: We do not sell users' personal data to third parties.

s23.title: 23. International transfers
s23.p1: Some of the technology providers used by Scoundrel's Quest may operate or process information from countries located outside the European Economic Area.
s23.p2: Where an international transfer of data takes place, it must be carried out in accordance with the mechanisms and safeguards established by applicable law.
s23.p3: In particular, the third-party services used for authentication, infrastructure or report management may be subject to their own conditions regarding location and data transfers.

s24.title: 24. User rights
s24.p1: Where data protection legislation applies, you may exercise the rights that correspond to you in relation to your personal data.
s24.li4: Right to request the restriction of processing.
s24.li5: Right to object to certain processing.
s24.li6: Right to data portability where applicable.

s25.title: 25. Complaints to a supervisory authority
s25.p1: If you consider that the processing of your personal data infringes applicable law and you have not obtained a satisfactory response, you can lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.

s26.p1: Scoundrel's Quest does not deliberately request additional personal data from minors that is not necessary to provide the features of the service.

s28.p1: The site may contain links to external websites or services.

s29.p1: The source code used to develop Scoundrel's Quest is publicly available on GitHub as part of the open and transparent nature of the project.

s30.title: 30. No sale of personal data
s30.p1: Scoundrel's Quest does not sell, rent out or trade in the personal data of its users.
s30.p2: The data is used to provide, maintain, protect and improve the service, as well as to manage the features you request.

s1.title: 1. What are cookies?
s1.p1: Cookies are small files or identifiers that may be stored on a user's device when they visit a website.
s1.p2: They may be used for different purposes, such as maintaining a session, storing preferences, applying security measures, carrying out statistical analysis or displaying advertising.

s2.title: 2. Cookies used by Scoundrel's Quest
s2.p1: Scoundrel's Quest uses only the cookies and similar technologies necessary to provide certain features of the service.
s2.intro: These technologies may be used, among other things, to:
s2.li1: Keep the user's session signed in.
s2.li2: Manage authentication and access to the account.
s2.li3: Remember certain preferences or settings necessary for the operation of the service.
s2.li4: Apply security and protection measures against malicious use.

s3.title: 3. Session and authentication cookies
s3.p1: The technologies needed to maintain an authenticated session may use identifiers associated with the user's session.
s3.p2: These technologies make it possible to recognise that the user has signed in and to maintain access to the corresponding features during the session.
s3.p3: Disabling these technologies may prevent or make difficult the sign-in process and certain features of the game.

s4.title: 4. Preferences and settings
s4.p1: Scoundrel's Quest may use local storage, cookies or other similar technologies to remember certain preferences needed for the operation of the site.
s4.p2: These technologies are not currently used to create advertising profiles of the user.

s5.title: 5. Cloudflare
s5.p1: Scoundrel's Quest uses Cloudflare as its DNS and proxy provider for certain connections to the service.
s5.p2: Depending on the configuration and the security features used, Cloudflare may use cookies or similar technologies related to security, abuse detection and traffic management.
s5.p3: Scoundrel's Quest does not use these technologies to serve targeted advertising or to carry out behavioural analytics within the game.

s6.title: 6. Google Analytics
s6.p1: Scoundrel's Quest does not currently use Google Analytics.
s6.p2: Therefore, Google Analytics cookies are not used to analyse player behaviour within the game.

s7.title: 7. Google Search Console
s7.p1: Scoundrel's Quest uses Google Search Console for tasks related to administering and monitoring the presence of the site in search results.
s7.p2: Search Console is not used as a behavioural analytics tool within the game.

s8.title: 8. Advertising cookies
s8.p1: Scoundrel's Quest does not currently use advertising or advertising cookies intended to display personalised ads or to create advertising profiles of users.

s9.title: 9. Consent
s9.p1: Cookies and technologies strictly necessary to provide features requested by the user may be exempt from the obligation to obtain consent, in accordance with applicable law.
s9.p2: If in the future cookies or technologies that were not strictly necessary for the operation of the service were introduced, this policy would be reviewed and, where necessary, the corresponding consent would be requested before they were used.

s10.title: 10. Cookie management
s10.p1: The user can manage, block or delete cookies through the settings options available in their browser.
s10.p2: Disabling certain cookies or technical technologies may cause some Scoundrel's Quest features not to work correctly, especially those related to signing in and to the user's session.

s11.title: 11. Changes to this policy
s11.p1: This Cookie Policy may be updated when the features of the site, the technologies used or the applicable regulations change.
s11.p2: The current version will be available on this page and will show the date of its last update.
